title: Extra hours, ordered in writing
summary: Pixelforge bills 50 render hours; Frappua's order says 40. The agents sort it out between themselves: the extra 10 hours were ordered by e-mail by Frappua's own producer, and the overrun is inside the tolerance Frappua's owner set.

title: Second scene, agreed only in a call
summary: Pixelforge bills two animated scenes; the order covers one. Nothing in writing for the second. The agents get as far as their owners allow, then both owners get a card and decide in one click.

entries.note: scene 2 delivered; asked for in a call with Erik on 14 Oct, no written confirmation

title: The same invoice, sent twice
summary: After a sync glitch Pixelforge's system raises the October render invoice a second time under a new number. Frappua's agent recognises the same work, same amount, already paid, and asks. Pixelforge's agent checks its own books and withdraws the PayPal invoice. Nobody is interrupted.
expect: refused and withdrawn by the agents
